description: How much of the $REGEN token itself changes hands — NOT Regen ecocredit retirement volume, a completely different market (use regen_burn_tracker or the commons page for that). Returns live price, 24h volume, market cap, a 7-day trend read off real daily history, a per-exchange/DEX breakdown of where that volume actually happens, and the peak/most-recent complete month from a year of monthly history (the human page at /regen/volume.html has a full daily/monthly chart toggle). Sourced from CoinGecko's own aggregation. Free, keyless, read-only.
name: regen_token_volume
title: REGEN token trading volume, across every exchange it trades on
